description: Compare 2 to 4 built-in model portfolios or canonical strategies side by side over their COMMON window, which is the only fair comparison: two pages' headline numbers usually cover different periods (a portfolio holding gold starts in 2004, the Ivy portfolio in 1996). Returns CAGR, volatility, max drawdown, Sharpe, Sortino, Ulcer index, best/worst year and longest time underwater on the aligned months, each portfolio's own full-window figures (labelled with their start), the pairwise correlation of their monthly returns and a calendar-year table. Use it for 'All Weather vs Golden Butterfly vs 60/40', 'which of these held up better'. Each item in `portfolios` has exactly one of `template` or `strategy` (ids from list_portfolios) and an optional `label`. Read-only, precomputed from the monthly refresh (data through the stated month). For one portfolio's detail use analyze_portfolio, portfolio_returns or portfolio_risk; custom allocations are not supported here.

label.description: Optional display name for this column.

template.description: Built-in model portfolio id (list_portfolios shows all 19).

years.description: Calendar-year rows to include (most recent N years of the common window; 0 = none). Default 10.

name: compare_portfolios
